description: This file contains implementation of expression handling functions used in a build configuration system, including creation, copying, comparison, transformation, and printing of expression trees for build symbol dependencies.

methods.name: struct:expr * expr_alloc_symbol(struct symbol * sym)
methods.description: Allocates a new expression node representing a symbol.

methods.name: struct:expr * expr_alloc_one(enum expr_type type,struct expr * ce)
methods.description: Allocates a new expression node of a given type with a single subexpression or symbol.

methods.name: struct:expr * expr_alloc_two(enum expr_type type,struct expr * e1,struct expr * e2)
methods.description: Allocates a new expression node of a given type with two subexpressions.

methods.name: struct:expr * expr_alloc_comp(enum expr_type type,struct symbol * s1,struct symbol * s2)
methods.description: Allocates a comparison expression node between two symbols.

methods.name: struct:expr * expr_copy(const struct expr * org)
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an expression tree.

methods.name: void expr_free(struct expr * e)
methods.description: Frees an expression tree.

methods.name: void expr_eliminate_eq(struct expr ** ep1,struct expr ** ep2)
methods.description: Eliminates common subexpressions in two expression trees.

methods.name: struct:expr * expr_eliminate_dups(struct expr * e)
methods.description: Removes duplicate operands in logical expressions.

methods.name: struct:expr * expr_transform(struct expr * e)
methods.description: Performs various simplifications and transformations on expressions.

methods.name: int expr_contains_symbol(struct expr * dep,struct symbol * sym)
methods.description: Checks if an expression contains a specific symbol.

methods.name: bool expr_depends_symbol(struct expr * dep,struct symbol * sym)
methods.description: Checks if an expression depends on a particular symbol.

methods.name: struct:expr * expr_trans_compare(struct expr * e,enum expr_type type,struct symbol * sym)
methods.description: Inserts explicit comparisons for a symbol into an expression.

methods.name: tristate expr_calc_value(struct expr * e)
methods.description: Calculates the boolean value of an expression.

methods.name: int expr_compare_type(enum expr_type t1,enum expr_type t2)
methods.description: Compares two expression types for ordering.

methods.name: void expr_print(struct expr * e,void (* fn)(void *,struct symbol *,const char *),void * data,int prevtoken)
methods.description: Prints an expression using a callback function.

methods.name: void expr_fprint(struct expr * e,FILE * out)
methods.description: Prints an expression to a FILE stream.

methods.name: void expr_gstr_print_revdep(struct expr * e,struct gstr * gs,tristate pr_type,const char * title)
methods.description: Prints reverse dependency expressions to a growing string structure.
